rounds.text: The market severely under-appreciates this business because it values the stock at a steep discount to its net assets, trading at a price-to-book ratio of just 0.57x compared to a sector benchmark of 1.31x [E2, E7]. Underlying commercial momentum is robust, highlighted by surging sales that show 33% year-over-year growth alongside sequential quarterly increases [E57, E60]. Operational efficiency is also turning a corner, with quarterly operating margins improving by 13 percentage points from -27% in the year-ago quarter to -14% by June 2026 [E23]. The bull relies on a 115% TTM profit growth figure [E17] to justify a P/E ratio of 60.48x [E6], but this valuation remains triple the sector benchmark of 20.07x [E6], exposing investors to extreme multiple compression risk.
